citations.assessment: Levi explicitly quotes Yose bar Ilai on counting by the greater and lesser luminaries.
The corresponding Bavli exchange gives Yosef son of Rav Ilai proposing the safeguard and Mesharshaya objecting. Heilprin’s summary reverses the roles.
Pinchas transmits the description of the sanctuary at Shiloh in the name of Yosah biRabbi Ilai. The target’s digital locator is 1:12:3.
